title: Sentier inventory source metadata
description: Provenance file (metadata.json) carried by each data/<source>-<source_version>/ folder. One folder holds exactly one published release of one datasource; sector is a column on processes.parquet. The source-to-row import log stays in sentier-importers.

source.description: Datasource id, lower-kebab <publisher>-<edition>, e.g. bafu-2026. Equals the single distinct processes.source value (CI-checked).

source_version.description: Publisher's release of that dataset, e.g. v1. Equals the single distinct processes.source_version value; the folder is named <source>-<source_version> (CI-checked).

license.description: Licence name, URL or terms-of-use summary as the publisher states it.

citation.description: The citation sentence the publisher requires.

provenance.description: sentier-vocab Source IRI of this datasource.

sectors.description: Sorted distinct processes.sector values present in this folder (CI-checked).
